notes: Address the user politely as நீங்கள் (implied); instructions and messages use the polite -வும் imperative (e.g. மீண்டும் முயலவும்). Buttons and menu items use the short bare imperative standard in Tamil software (சேமி, நீக்கு, பகிர், ரத்துசெய்), labels and headings are nouns. Tamil has no capitals; keep product names (Paper Bible, Lulu, Google) in Latin script and attach case suffixes with a hyphen (Lulu-வின், PDF-ஐ). Use “curly” double quotes; keep the English em dash (—) and ellipsis as in the source. Option names on English-only external sites (Lulu, Google Fonts) stay in English, sometimes with a Tamil gloss; printer-dialog terms get the Tamil name with the English in parentheses. Bible quotations follow the classic BSI Tamil Bible wording.
